name: Pair of K16 turbochargers of the 993 Turbo (PicoGK display concept), gyroid core (PicoGK)
picogk_enhancement: Gyroid core: the published PicoGK body (bionic_topology) keeps its outer form; a 3.75 mm skin encloses a sheet gyroid (28.125 mm cell, 3.125 mm wall) wherever the body holds three cells, thinner zones and functional features stay solid, drain ports run to the nearest outer surface and any pocket they miss is filled solid. Core settings are assumptions for the lpbf metal class; nothing here is printed, depowdered or tested.

cell_mm.note: gyroid period; at least 9 walls so the channels stay open to the drains

wall_mm.note: gyroid sheet thickness; class minimum 0.4 mm, at least 2.5 voxels

skin_mm.note: outer skin; class minimum 0.8 mm, at least 3 voxels

min_cells.note: owner rule 2026-10-22: core only where three cells fit, else solid

drain_d_mm.note: powder/resin drain diameter; class minimum 2.0 mm

max_drains.note: lowest and highest core points, then farthest-point spread

open_interfaces: all flanges, fasteners, V-band / clamp geometry, oil and coolant ports
true volute A/R, tongue and clocking (declared A/R and clocking in the record are not modelled)
left/right units are mirrored here; the real units differ (6735 right, 6736 left)
discharge crossover / intercooler routing is schematic
status: F0 concept geometry - not fitted, not tested, not safe, not released, not a print file
